title: Basil Gogos
description: Basil Gogos. a noted science fiction illustrator, got a mean-spirited Tusken Raider to pose long enough for this menacing 1978 cover portrait for FAMOUS MONSTERS magazine (front). Don Maitz, who won last year's Hugo Award as the world's best science fiction artist, used a restraining bolt to keep R2-D2 immobile for this 1977 FAMOUS MONSTERS cover (back, collection of William Plumb).
